text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I worked really hard to make it 
glossy using icing cream and kohakuto!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Plus, they're made with okara and other 
ingredients... They're cookies that'll 
fill you with energy! After all, I'm the 
"Nutritional Warrior" Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Believe-san was the one who made it 
look so realistic!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm adjusting the ratio of the mask's 
green part to the leaves so that it's 
strictly 1 to 2.5.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—!? That's just like the secret of the 
mask Dr. Veggie talked about in Episode 
6...!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And and! For the eyes, I made them out of 
candy so that they could see properly! 
They're colored yellow carrot!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And the super-thin kohakuto Believe 
prepared was so sparkly! And the icing was 
done so well, too!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I also added the small pattern on the 
back of the mask, just in case. It was 
listed in the reference material, 'The 
Complete Carrotman Encyclopedia.'"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you! Both of you! A birthday 
present like thisâ... Whoaaah?!
